 I’m not sure who needs to hear this, but Black Friday is one of the best times to shop for beauty products. Since folks tend to mad-dash to save big on major ticket items like gaming consoles and televisions, they often forget those aren’t the only things on sale. This is usually when you can find the best and most unexpected deals on your favorite beauty brands . And with the busiest shopping day of the year only a week away, EltaMD just dropped a ton of Black Friday deals on Amazon.
 Known as the #1 Dermatologist-Recommended Professional Sunscreen Brand, EltaMD is one of those brands that you want to stock up on anytime there’s a sale. With proven formulas most of the beauty industry swears by, the suncare brand can get pretty pricey. Their coveted bottle of UV Clear Face Sunscreen regularly costs close to $80, so any savings are worth it — and this weekend it’s 20% off for Black Friday . And it doesn’t stop there.
